audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart (phases[N].side/.rating) contradicts the content-layer win[N] on all seven rows: full says Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill, content says Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Zilean. The packet's independent levelChart (Skill,Skill,Hwei,Hwei,Hwei,Hwei,Zilean) matches content exactly.
audit.why: Content's whys[] already give a grounded, kit-correct account (even early poke, Hwei's range wins 3-6/first item, Zilean's Chronoshift wins late) that matches the packet. Per the chart rule, win[N] is already correct, so only the full layer (side/rating/why) needs to move to agree.
audit.corrected: phases[0-1].side moved Hwei->Skill, phases[2-5].side moved Skill->Hwei, phases[6].side moved Skill->Zilean, ratings and whys updated to match.

audit.why: Spikes correctly identify level 2 as even, level 6/first-item as Hwei's range window, and late (2+ items) as Zilean's Chronoshift/Time Warp turnaround.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeatedly names a fabricated ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', which does not exist in Hwei's kit (real abilities: P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair, per packet.defects and enemyAbilities). Hwei's CC lives on E (Subject: Torment, which paints Grim Visage/Gaze of the Abyss/Crushing Maw per the kit text and its hardCC flag). breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit (lint), and dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d are tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim under unrelated titles (lint).
audit.why: The fabricated name appears in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and report[9].t. All are corrected to 'Subject: Torment (E)', the real ability that carries his hardCC flag. breakdown.cooldowns now cites its real per-rank cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) plus Zilean's E and R cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Fabricated ability name replaced with Subject: Torment (E) everywhere it appears; cooldowns field given real numbers; the two bleed bullets reworded distinctly from tradeGood/tradeBad.
